install.notes: Upstream stack only: Isaac Sim 4.5 and Isaac Lab 2.1.1 on Ubuntu 22.04 with an NVIDIA GPU (README.md:40-41 and docs/source/installation/Local-Installation.md:2-6); no command is recorded or run here. The gate and the package fake need neither: fake.py is pure Python and the gate never imports the clone. The sim backend would call gymnasium.make(env_id), but the upstream tasks are constructed with gym.make(task_name, cfg=env_cfg) and the cfg exists only inside the Isaac Lab stack, so only the package fake backend is provided.
